artworks.title: Saints Peter and Paul under a Canopy
The Man with Two Trumpets
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of nude and semi-nude figures engaged in various activities. The composition shows five figures positioned in an outdoor setting with classical architecture in the background. On the left, two figures are interacting with a large sphere suspended by two sticks. A central figure is seated with an object overhead, while another stands with outstretched arms, holding a long object. The rightmost figures include a bearded figure draped in a robe, standing beside another figure. The drawing shows intricate line work and attention to anatomical detail, reflecting a high level of technical skill.

artworks.title: A Censer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate sculpture featuring two draped female figures supporting a decorative urn. The drawing depicts two allegorical female figures standing back to back in classical draped attire, both posed with one hand raised to support an intricately designed urn on their heads. The urn is adorned with a lattice pattern, fantastical creatures, and a grotesque mask in relief. The base includes ram motifs and ornate detailing. Fine lines and hatching techniques are used to create depth and texture, giving the drawing a highly detailed appearance, reminiscent of classical art forms and architectural ornamentation.

artworks.title: Hope
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a full-length view standing barefoot and looking over their right shoulder. The person has detailed facial features, an updo hairstyle, and is wearing a flowing garment with a waistband. They hold a large bowl in their right hand. The background features a textured wall with a halo effect and decorative lines.

artworks.title: Prudence
artworks.description: This print depicts a person standing with one foot in front of the other. Their face is turned to the left, with one arm curved upward and touching their head, and their other arm extended downward with a snake curled around their wrist. They have a straight nose and wear a neutral expression, with their eyes looking outward. Their long curly hair is pulled back from their head by a cloth headband, with a long section flowing down their back. Out of that section of hair appears another face, which is turned towards the right. This second face appears older, with a low brow, long nose, and a beard that flows into the hair of the left face. The body of the person is mostly nude and wrapped loosely in a thin fabric that is hung diagonally around their body and bunched at the waist. The fabric appears to be see-through, as details of the person’s stomach and legs are visible beneath it. The person stands in a shaded archway or niche set into a plain wall. The print is monochromatic, with dark lines on white paper.

artworks.title: Charity
artworks.description: The image shows a woman holding two children.

artworks.title: Faith
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their body slightly turned to the side. The person's head is raised, with a focused gaze, and they have pronounced facial features. Their hair is styled in waves, flowing down to the shoulders, with strands gathered behind the head. The person wears a draped garment cinched at the waist, revealing their form. They are barefoot, with one foot placed slightly ahead of the other. The figure holds an object in their left hand and touches the edge of the dress with their right hand. In the background, there is an arched niche with a vertical line pattern.

artworks.title: Justice
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a woman in a dynamic pose, facing away with her head turned to the side. She has a prominent nose and relaxed expression. Her long hair is wavy and tied back, with loose strands. She wears a flowing gown and holds a large sword in her right hand and scales of justice in her left hand. The background features a textured, arched frame around her head.

artworks.title: Fortitude
artworks.description: The image features a person standing in a relaxed pose, with one hand on their hip, leaning against a column. They have curly hair, finely crafted facial features, and wear a flowing gown with ornamental elements. The background is textured, highlighting the figure's stance in an arched niche.

artworks.title: Temperance
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.1 x 10.8 cm (8 11/16 x 4 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their body slightly turned to the side. The individual has their left foot forward, left hand on their hip, and their right arm extended outward holding a decorative key on a ring, along with some draped cords. The person has classical facial features with wavy hair, partially covered by a headpiece, styled back with loose curls falling behind the head. They are wearing a draped garment flowing down to their ankles, exposing bare feet. The background consists of a textured surface with an arched niche creating depth behind the subject.

artworks.title: God Appearing to Noah
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures at a doorway. Two figures are on the left, one carrying the other, approaching a large wooden door. Nearby, a robed figure kneels on the ground, embracing a child. On the right, a woman carrying a child stands at the doorway. The pen-and-ink drawing shows texture and depth in the robes and door. Diagonal lines create a sense of movement and urgency.

artworks.title: Giovanni Filoteo Achillini
artworks.description: The illustration depicts a person sitting on a stump playing a guitar. The individual is sitting cross-legged, wearing medieval-style clothing and a cap. They have long curly hair, a straight nose, and slightly pursed lips. The background shows a rustic landscape with hills, trees, buildings, and fluffy clouds in the sky. A cat-like creature is nearby, along with a scroll on a tree.

artworks.title: Hercules and Antaeus
artworks.description: The image depicts two mythological figures in a confrontation. One figure is muscular and bearded, holding the other figure around the midsection. The background includes an ancient structure with columns, arches, trees, and rocky terrain. The style of the image appears to be an engraving or etching, emphasizing detail and dramatic tension.

artworks.title: Joseph and Potiphar's Wife
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.8 x 24.6 cm (8 3/16 x 9 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in classical attire in an interior setting with draped curtains. The scene is set within a room where one figure appears to be pulling at the garment of another figure who is moving away. The backdrop is composed of richly draped curtains, and the floor and supporting structure add depth to the composition. The action between the figures is dynamic, with detailed attention to the flowing drapery and the figures' postures conveying movement and tension. In the background, there is a sculptural figure that adds to the classical atmosphere of the setting. The drawing is executed with fine lines and hatching to create shading and dimension.

artworks.title: Madonna under a Palm Tree
artworks.description: The image shows four people. Two women are seated on the ground, one holding a child, while a young boy kneels in front of them. The woman on the right has stylized hair tied back and a halo above her head. She is dressed in a long gown and has her hands together. The woman beside her is wearing a headdress and looking down at the unclothed child she is holding. The kneeling boy has curly hair, wears a simple garment tied at the waist, and holds a stick with a cross at the top. In the background, there is a palm tree behind the group, a wooden structure to the left, and a hilly landscape with buildings and trees in the distance.

artworks.title: Venus and Cupid
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17.8 x 13.2 cm (7 x 5 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This print depicts two people sitting on a dirt mound next to a tree. On the right, a woman is seated, with one arm resting on the shoulder of a boy next to her on the left. Her other arm is bent with her hand resting on her chest. She has curly hair styled in an updo with a small, pointed tiara. Her face is turned downward, and her eyes appear closed. The woman is nude, apart from a draped cloth across her lap. The child is beside her on the left, looking towards her. He has one arm bent, holding a long arrow across his body with the point facing the woman. His other arm is extended out to the left, resting on the top of a bow. He is also nude. On the ground beside the bow appears to be a quiver filled with more arrows. The child has curly hair and a headband across his forehead. On the left, the background features a detailed group of buildings with pointed and domed roofs across a body of water. The sky above is mostly clear.

artworks.title: Two Sibyls and an Angel
artworks.artist: Giovanni Antonio da Brescia after Raphael
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures in an artistic scene. In the lower section, there are two full-length figures - a seated person and a standing person, both draped in flowing garments. The seated figure, to the left, has a hood over their head and appears to be resting on a structure resembling a capital, holding a book in their lap. The standing figure, on the right, is dressed in flowing robes, facing slightly towards the seated person. Above these two figures, a winged cherubic figure is behind a stone plinth, with its arms resting on it. At the top of the image, an angelic figure is shown in mid-flight, holding a scroll, with spread wings and flowing hair. The background is filled with clouds surrounding the lower figures, creating a celestial setting. The artistic style is monochromatic, with intricate linework emphasizing textures and folds of the clothing and celestial atmosphere.

artworks.title: Claude Renoir, head lowered (Claude Renoir, la tete baissee)
artworks.description: The image shows an artistic rendering of the upper portion of a young child's body, focusing on the head and shoulders. The child is facing slightly downwards and to the side, with a subtle tilt of the head. The facial features are softly depicted, with eyes downcast. The child's hair is long, extending past the shoulders, and includes a bow or hair ribbon. The clothing consists of a garment with a high, ruffled collar and textured patterns. There is no visible jewelry or objects held by the child. The background is a plain, textured surface, with an overall light and smooth appearance.

artworks.title: Claude Renoir, turned left (Claude Renoir, tourne a gauche)
artworks.description: The image is a charcoal portrait of a young child, shown from the shoulders up. The child is in a three-quarter profile, facing slightly to the left. The facial features are softly drawn, with a gentle expression. The child's hair is long, falling around the face in wavy strands. A hint of clothing is visible, suggested by subtle lines indicating a ruffled neckline. The background is an indistinct blurred space. The artist's signature appears at the bottom right corner of the image.

artworks.title: On the Beach - At Berneval (Sur la plage - a Berneval)
artworks.description: This is a painting of figures on a beach. The painting depicts two figures sitting on a shore, with their backs turned, observing a group of smaller figures near or in the water. The figures sitting by the shore are drawn with a loose, flowing style, adding to the casual and relaxed atmosphere of the scene. The light, sketch-like quality of the outlines and shading suggests a study of leisure and tranquility near water.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome Hearing the Trumpet of the Last Judgment
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly man seated on rocky terrain. He is slightly hunched forward, with his left elbow resting on a surface, and his right arm bent across his chest. The man's face appears gaunt, with deep-set eyes, unkempt curly hair, and a bushy beard. He is mostly unclothed, with only a draped cloth covering his lower body. Various objects surround him including a skull, a rolled scroll, and a piece of cloth or parchment. In the upper right corner, a heavenly figure is shown with only an arm visible, holding a trumpet pointed towards the man. The background shows a dramatic, cloud-filled sky.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene with figures gathered around a central figure holding a child. The characters are dressed in flowing robes and display reverence and devotion. Some figures are kneeling while others stand. Angelic figures are hovering above them. The background shows mountains and clouds. The drawing features intricate line work and detailed shading. The composition focuses on religious themes and storytelling.

artworks.title: Saint Sebastian and Saint Roch
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 21 x 13.8 cm (8 1/4 x 5 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. On the left, a figure with long hair leans against a tree with one hand tied to a branch. They wear only a cloth around their waist. The figure on the right holds a staff, has curly hair and a beard, and wears a robe. An angel flies above, holding a crown. Trees and shrubbery are in the background.

artworks.title: Allegory of Mother Earth
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman with several cherubic infants. The woman is in the center, holding a stick with a basket of fruits and a garland over her shoulder. She sits on rocky terrain, with long wavy hair and a headband. The infants are depicted nude, with curly hair, surrounding the woman and engaging in various activities. The background includes a barren landscape with trees, hills, a house with a watermill, and a cloudy sky.
